requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Aggregate of security, compliance, and audit requirements to ensure the protection of patient data and compliance with regulations.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Aggregate of scalability, uptime, and performance requirements to ensure the system can handle a high volume of users and data without degradation.

requirements.title: Real-time Insurance Eligibility Check
requirements.description: Perform real-time insurance eligibility check via payer EDI 270/271 transactions

requirements.title: Co-pay and Deductible Display
requirements.description: Display co-pay and deductible amounts before appointment booking

requirements.title: Itemized Billing Statements
requirements.description: Make itemized billing statements available in portal with PDF download

requirements.title: Online Payment Options
requirements.description: Offer online payment via credit card, HSA/FSA card, and bank transfer

requirements.title: Payment Plan Setup Wizard
requirements.description: The wizard involves selecting a balance, choosing a plan, calculating the monthly amount, and confirming with ACH auto-pay authorization.

requirements.title: Billing Dispute Submission
requirements.description: Allow billing dispute submission with document attachment and status tracking

requirements.title: Automated Claim Submission
requirements.description: Submit claims to insurance payers via EDI 837 format

requirements.title: Denial Management Workflow
requirements.description: Implement denial management workflow with appeal letter templates

requirements.title: Patient Demographics Screen
requirements.description: Displays patient demographics information, including name, date of birth, and address, synchronized with EHR via FHIR Patient resource every 15 minutes.

requirements.title: Appointment Resource Creation
requirements.description: Appointment resources created in EHR when patient books via portal. FHIR Appointment resource with status lifecycle: proposed -> booked -> arrived -> fulfilled -> cancelled.

requirements.title: Lab Results Screen
requirements.description: Displays lab results consumed from the EHR via FHIR DiagnosticReport and Observation resources, using LOINC codes for standardized test identification.

requirements.title: Medication List Synchronization
requirements.description: Medication lists synchronized via FHIR MedicationRequest resource. Includes RxNorm codes for drug identification.

requirements.title: SMART on FHIR Authorization
requirements.description: SMART on FHIR authorization for third-party app access to patient data with granular scope control.

requirements.title: Medication History Query
requirements.description: Medication history query (RxHistoryRequest) retrieves 12-month fill history from all pharmacies.

requirements.title: Real-time Formulary and Benefit Check
requirements.description: Real-time formulary and benefit check (RxBenefitCheck) shows patient cost estimate before prescribing.

requirements.title: Remittance Advice
requirements.description: Remittance advice (ERA) received via X12 EDI 835. Auto-posted to patient accounts.

requirements.title: Claim Status Inquiry
requirements.description: Claim status inquiry via X12 EDI 276/277 for tracking adjudication progress.

requirements.title: Telehealth Appointment Sequence Flow
requirements.description: Telehealth appointment sequence flow: patient books appointment, scheduling service creates appointment resource, notification service sends confirmation, patient joins video visit, provider joins as host, video session is active, and clinical notes are posted.

requirements.title: Patient Profile Display
requirements.description: The patient profile display shows demographics, allergies, medications, and conditions.

requirements.title: Medical History Timeline
requirements.description: The medical history timeline shows a chronological view of visits, tests, and diagnoses.

requirements.title: Appointment Scheduling Workflow
requirements.description: A multi-step process for scheduling an appointment, including selecting a patient, choosing a provider, picking a date and time, and confirming the appointment. The workflow should include decision points for checking provider availability and patient eligibility.

requirements.title: Video Consultation with Zoom API
requirements.description: Integrated video consultation using Zoom Healthcare API with HIPAA BAA

requirements.title: Virtual Waiting Room
requirements.description: Virtual waiting room with estimated wait time and position in queue

requirements.title: Screen Sharing Capability
requirements.description: Screen sharing capability for providers to review lab results with patients

requirements.title: Recording Capability
requirements.description: Recording capability with patient consent, stored encrypted for 3 years

requirements.title: Wearable Device Integration
requirements.description: Integration with wearable devices (Apple Watch, Fitbit) for vitals data

requirements.title: Automated Alerts
requirements.description: Automated alerts when patient vitals exceed provider-configured thresholds

requirements.title: Remote Monitoring Dashboard
requirements.description: A dashboard where providers can view remote monitoring data trends for their patients, including vitals data from wearable devices.

requirements.title: Symptom Checker Chatbot
requirements.description: A chatbot that guides patients through a symptom checker process to determine the appropriate level of care, with triage results shared with the provider before consultation.

requirements.title: Triage Results Sharing
requirements.description: Triage results shared with provider before consultation for preparation

requirements.title: Emergency Symptoms Alert
requirements.description: Emergency symptoms must trigger immediate alert with 911 contact option

requirements.title: Patient Dashboard
requirements.description: A screen displaying patient information, including medical history, appointments, and prescriptions. It should include filtering logic to view specific types of data and have interactive components for scheduling appointments and prescribing medication.

requirements.title: Appointment Booking Calendar Screen
requirements.description: The calendar displays in month view by default, with available slots shown as small green dots on dates. Unavailable dates are dimmed, and past dates are not clickable.

requirements.title: Telehealth Video Consultation Pre-Check
requirements.description: The pre-consultation check screen shows three status indicators: Camera (green check/red X), Microphone (green check/red X), Speaker (green check/red X), with a 'Test' button next to each.

requirements.title: Lab Results Viewer Expandable Cards
requirements.description: Lab results are listed as expandable cards grouped by test date (most recent first), with each card header showing: test name, date, overall status badge ('Normal' green, 'Abnormal' red, 'Pending' yellow).

requirements.title: Billing & Payment Outstanding Balance Display
requirements.description: The outstanding balance is displayed prominently at the top in a blue card: total amount (28px bold), 'Pay Now' button.

requirements.title: New Patient Registration
requirements.description: Patient creates account, completes profile setup, and navigates to book appointment

requirements.title: Prescription Refill
requirements.description: Prescription refill workflow, including patient request, provider review, and pharmacy notification

requirements.title: Insurance Claim and Billing
requirements.description: System auto-generates EDI 837 Professional claim, submits to patient's insurance payer, and generates patient statement

requirements.title: Apointment Booking & Scheduling
requirements.description: Appointment booking and scheduling functionality for the Healthcare Patient Portal

requirements.title: Telehealth Consultation Execution
requirements.description: Telehealth consultation execution functionality for the Healthcare Patient Portal

requirements.title: Patient Billing Portal
requirements.description: The system shall provide itemized billing statements available in the portal with PDF download. The system shall allow online payment via credit card, HSA/FSA card, and bank transfer. The system shall set up payment plans for balances over $500 with automatic monthly charges.

requirements.title: Prescription Management Screen
requirements.description: A screen for managing prescriptions, including viewing current medications, prescribing new medications, and tracking refills. It should include form fields for medication name, dosage, and frequency, along with validation rules for ensuring proper prescription formatting.

requirements.title: Claims Processing Workflow
requirements.description: The system shall automate claim submission to insurance payers via EDI 837 format. The system shall track claim status (submitted, accepted, denied, paid) visible to staff. The system shall provide a denial management workflow with appeal letter templates.

requirements.title: Secure Messaging
requirements.description: The secure messaging process allows patients to communicate with providers.

requirements.title: WCAG 2.1 Compliance
requirements.description: Portal must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. All images must have alt text. Forms must have associated labels.

requirements.title: Screen Reader Compatibility
requirements.description: Screen reader compatibility tested with NVDA (Windows) and VoiceOver (macOS/iOS).

requirements.title: Color Contrast Ratio
requirements.description: Color contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. All status indicators must not rely solely on color.

requirements.title: Keyboard Navigation
requirements.description: All interactive elements reachable via keyboard. Visible focus indicator on all focusable elements.

requirements.title: HL7 FHIR Compliance
requirements.description: HL7 FHIR R4 compliance validated using Touchstone test suite before each major release.

requirements.title: Surescripts Certification
requirements.description: Surescripts certification renewal annually. Must pass all 36 mandatory validation scenarios.

requirements.title: X12 EDI Compliance
requirements.description: X12 EDI transactions must comply with HIPAA 5010 standards. Validation via Edifecs before submission.

requirements.title: Prevent Regression of Defect SADRSTRANG-13583
requirements.description: Prevent regression of defect SADRSTRANG-13583
